import html # The HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Custom Response

Your Content

{user_content}
""" def generate_html_response(user_content: str) -> str: """ Generates an HTML page by embedding the provided user content into a predefined template. Args: user_content (str): The user-provided text to include in the HTML response. Returns: str: A complete HTML document with the escaped user content inserted. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS attacks safe_content = html.escape(user_content, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
